posts.post_subject: List of holograms I wish to make
posts.content_md:
I am sure I am not the only one that has a to-do list for holograms but here are some of mine in no particular order although the first on the list is my priority right now.

Finish the "Factual Color Shifted" DCG experiements and if successful apply to an object

Try the Vaccuum chamber DCG hologram.

Shoot the photopolymer I have.

Make a hologram of the statuette I have

Try 8 x 10 DCG fabrication and holography - need larger alcohol trays

Try an imaged plane proximity reflection copy from reflection master

Try the focused image hologram - I have the 6" lens

Try the focused one shot stereogram

Try the self developing DCG process

Try the two/three layer DCG hologram

Make the Fish Tank hologram - with water and bubbles

Try the Moving Plate hologram

Try some additives to DCG I have in mind

Make the Top Hat BeamShaper HOE - excess light not wasted.

Make a DCG with Ruby Red replay

Try the inside out object hologram

Remake the Save The Earth hologram in 8 x 10 DCG

Try the Single Beam, Single Exposure, Imaged Planed Rainbow hologram - I have the drawing

At the rate I am going with the time I have and the adversities I constantly need to overcome, I may get these done by the year 2008.
